title: Model and effort named at launch
requirement: every session viola starts names its model and its effort explicitly, viola's configured default where none is given; the pair is recorded per instance as a closed set of values and replayed on a resume, so `open`, `up` and `adopt` inherit it
acceptance: A session started with no model or effort given runs on viola's configured default pair, one started with a pair runs on it, and after a resume, an open, an up or an adopt the session runs on the pair its instance recorded.
